solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Namirial's workload.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Namirial's application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Indexes and retrieves vector embeddings for semantic search and generative-AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts foundation models used for Namirial's planned generative-AI document workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Titan Embeddings
solution_components.role: Creates document embeddings for semantic retrieval over archived records.

data_flow: Documents, logs, or product records are stored in MongoDB Atlas, embedded or indexed for MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and queried by Namirial's application workflows to return relevant results in real time.
metrics: For example, the company migrated to MongoDB Atlas on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in 2020 and within two years had 1 billion documents stored in its conservation system.
This figure rose to 3 billion by 2023.
architecture_clues: Sharding is used to scale data horizontally.
Autoscaling is used to absorb demand spikes and control costs.
High-availability cluster deployment is part of the design.
Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for AI and semantic search workloads.
Full-text or faceted search runs inside the MongoDB platform.
